hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */.claude/projects/*/memory/*) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Writing to Claude memory is forbidden here (code-standards.md: do not use auto-memory). Propose a guideline edit instead."}}';; esac

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq 'git[[:space:]]+commit' && printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eiq 'co-authored-by:|generated with \[claude|noreply@anthropic'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"No Co-Authored-By/Claude references in commit messages (git-workflow.md). Use a subject-line-only message."}}'; fi
